art_direction: Low-poly, chunky, dramatic ancient-world illustration with sculpted readable silhouettes and warm directional light. Single centered subject, clean uncluttered background, strong value separation at 32 px. No words, letters, numerals, labels, borders, UI, or watermark. Square image, transparent or simple neutral backdrop.
